summary: Computes an element pointer from the array at this+0x10 using a 36-byte stride and an index read from a2+4, then calls LinkedListNodeInsert_0ad0(this, element) and returns the inserted node pointer. Called by VehgenScnFileLoader.

operations.description: Read the index as the dword at a2+4.
Compute the element pointer as *(this+0x10) + 36 * index (36-byte element stride).
Call LinkedListNodeInsert_0ad0(this, element) to insert the computed element into the list.
Return the pointer returned by LinkedListNodeInsert_0ad0 (the inserted node).

unresolved: LinkedListNodeInsert_0ad0 is not in the packet callee list; its address and contract are unknown.
Element type and meaning of the 36-byte stride (array at this+0x10) depend on the caller's layout.
Semantics of the index field a2+4 (index into which array) are unknown.
Packet prelabel describes this as a getter returning field 0x10, but the raw source returns the result of the insert call; raw source is authoritative.
